scope: Watch YouTube in Voice Companion, and new choices to keep Thunderbird and Chrome out of your way.

topics.title: YouTube
details: Choose YouTube in the Media menu, or say YouTube.
Hear your Home videos and search with filters. You can also open your subscriptions, history and playlists.
Use simple keys to play, pause, skip, change speed and volume, turn captions on, and go to the next video.
Press Alt for the YouTube menu with every action and its key.
Like, subscribe and save ask Yes or No first.
To use your account, say sign in. It works in guided Chrome, where you type your own email and password.

topics.title: Thunderbird window choice
details: In Options, Email, you can choose Minimized, as before, or Hidden from the taskbar.
Hidden from the taskbar keeps Thunderbird out of Alt+Tab.
Sign-in windows always come to the front, and you hear what they are.
While you add an account or sign in, nothing is hidden.
Say show Thunderbird or hide Thunderbird at any time.

topics.title: Guided Chrome window choice
details: In Options, Web browser, you can choose to run guided Chrome in the background.
A window still opens for Google sign-in, a person check, payment or picking a file.
Say show browser window or hide browser window at any time.

topics.title: If something goes wrong
details: The old way is still the first choice, and it is still what you get unless you change it.
If anything goes wrong, choose the first option to go back to how it was.
